summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing the re-engagement of IR Agency LLC under a revised consulting agreement after completing its voluntary delisting from the TSX Venture Exchange on September 1, 2026. The three-month agreement, effective September 3, 2026, provides for up to ten news distribution campaigns for a non-refundable US$2,500,000 fee payable in advance, funded by amounts returned under the rescinded original agreement. The company's common shares continue to trade on Nasdaq under XRTX. This is a routine business service contract, not a special situation.
